The PERSON who asked for this record. Stamped by the BFF only (field-secured by scripts/Set-ChildRecordCreatorPersonSchema.ps1, which task 081 extends): createdby is the BFF application user for a record the BFF creates app-only, so this column is what records the person. ebilling-r1 task 080 (O-23; D-173 shape).

The rule (policy) a rule-level override switches off on this record (O-10). CASCADE: a deleted rule deletes its override, so a nulled rule can never read as a Procedure-level Exclude. The ONLY parental (Delete Cascade) relationship of this table.
Optional firm the override is limited to (6.3). RESTRICT: a nulled firm would widen the override to every firm (task 080 proposal).

The matter this assignment or override is on. Exactly one core lookup is set on a row (enforced by the BFF). REMOVELINK, not Cascade: Dataverse counts Delete Cascade as parental and a table can have only one parental relationship, so the core-record delete planner (task 117) deletes the record's assignment rows first, with the 117 sweep as the backstop. Never Restrict to a core record.
Follow latest (the version in force on the work date), Pinned (the Pinned Version whatever is newer) or Excluded (the Procedure or rule does not apply here). Model 6.2.
